topic: Lettering of the cognate object examples
claim: The prose cites the cognate object examples as [i] and [ii]. “Thus [i] means essentially the same as She fought heroically”, and [ii] “likewise describes the manner of his dying”.
evidence_summary: Example [11] is lettered a and b: [11a] She fought a heroic fight., [11b] He died a long and agonising death.
proposed_wording: Thus [a] means essentially the same as She fought heroically; [b] likewise describes the manner of his dying
inference: Do the prose references match the example’s lettering?
